comparison.objective: Bimanually shake a loaded sieve so soil passes through while pebbles remain.
comparison.physical_skill: Level two-handle lifting and sustained controlled shaking of granular contents.
comparison.success_condition: Pass specified quantities of 72 crumbs into the tub, retain every pebble, and return the sieve to its battens. No separate spec is available.
comparison.reason: Tests dynamic sifting and material separation, not localized notch fracture with a mandrel and hammer or fragment recovery.
